description: This PHP source file defines the SnsClient class used for interacting with Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) within the AWS SDK. It includes method annotations for various SNS operations and extends the AwsClient base class.

classes.name: SnsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Amazon SNS, extending AwsClient, with methods for SNS operations.

methods.name: addPermission
methods.description: Adds a new permission to a topic.

methods.name: addPermissionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a new permission to a topic.

methods.name: checkIfPhoneNumberIsOptedOut
methods.description: Checks whether the phone number is opted out.

methods.name: checkIfPhoneNumberIsOptedOutAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously checks whether the phone number is opted out.

methods.name: confirmSubscription
methods.description: Confirms a subscription to an SNS topic.

methods.name: createPlatformApplication
methods.description: Creates a platform application object for the user.

methods.name: createPlatformEndpoint
methods.description: Creates an endpoint for a device platform.

methods.name: createSMSSandboxPhoneNumber
methods.description: Creates a sandbox phone number for testing SMS in SNS.

methods.name: createSMSSandboxPhoneNumberAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a sandbox phone number.

methods.name: deleteSMSSandboxPhoneNumberAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a sandbox phone number.

methods.name: getDataProtectionPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the data protection policy.

methods.name: getPlatformApplicationAttributes
methods.description: Gets attributes of a platform application.

methods.name: getSMSSandboxAccountStatusAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the sandbox account status.

methods.name: listPhoneNumbersOptedOut
methods.description: Lists phone numbers that have opted out.

methods.name: optInPhoneNumber
methods.description: Opt in a phone number for SMS.

methods.name: optInPhoneNumberAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously opt in a phone number.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Publishes a message to a topic or endpoint.

methods.name: putDataProtectionPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sets the data protection policy.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from a topic.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes an endpoint to a topic.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes an endpoint from a topic.

methods.name: verifySMSSandboxPhoneNumber
methods.description: Verifies an SMS sandbox phone number.

methods.name: verifySMSSandboxPhoneNumberAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously verifies an SMS sandbox phone number.
